# §7 Peer Benchmarking — Highlight Candidates

1. **Platform adoption in the top quartile** — adoption score of 89 (peer median: 78) places Charleston Forge in the top 15% of comparable accounts. The team uses a broader and deeper set of features than typical peers on the same plan. [→ §peer]
2. **Engagement and trajectory scores are the widest peer gaps** — engagement at 20 (peer median: 35) and trajectory at 30 (peer median: 80) indicate declining platform interaction frequency despite strong feature adoption depth. [→ §peer]
3. **Orders per user is well below peer midpoint** — at 0.08 orders per user vs. a peer median of 0.83, many platform users engage for browsing and presentation but don't submit orders. [→ §peer]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MEDIUM**: Address the engagement-trajectory gap — strong adoption but declining engagement and trajectory scores suggest the team is using fewer features less frequently. Re-engagement campaigns, refreshed training, and feature re-introduction could reverse the trajectory decline. [→ §peer]
